name: Beskonechnaja progulka
source:
"The Endless walk? Yes, I know about it. A survival game organized by Meta Semyon. He promises the impossible to anyone who can cover 410 kilometers in a continuous journey, through shifting landscapes and climate conditions. But do not be too quick to rejoice, my friends, because only the last survivor will get a ticket to freedom. Unfair? You should be thankful for even this much. And now get ready, a long walk awaits you. May Meta Semyon bless you."

[Translated from [url=https://vk.com/wall-196459787_677]VK[/url]]
translation:
“无尽的行走？是的，我知道。梅塔·谢苗组织的生存游戏。他向任何能够在不断变化的地形和气候条件下连续走完410公里的人承诺不可能的事。但不要太高兴，我的朋友们，因为只有最后的幸存者才能获得自由的门票。不公平？即使这么多，你也应该心存感激。现在准备好，漫长的步行等待着你。愿梅塔·谢苗祝福你。”

[翻译自[url=https://vk.com/wall-196459787_677]VK[/url]]
